name: Mailgun

evidence.transactional: F02: app-generated transactional email through the REST API or SMTP relay

line: Email API and SMTP for app email and bulk delivery to lists.

free.text: 100 emails/day listed; verified-domain guide gives a different cap

cells.newsletters: Yes, list/API bulk sending; no visual campaign composer
cells.api: Yes, REST API and SMTP relay

subs.math: The Basic plan includes 10,000 emails a month, covering 4,000 campaign emails.
The Foundation plan includes 50,000 emails a month, covering 20,000 campaign emails.
The Foundation plan includes 50,000 emails a month, covering 40,000 campaign emails.
Scale $90 + 100,000 extra emails at the vendor's 'from' rate of $1.10 per 1,000 = $200 minimum. The actual 200K tier price is not published.

appmail.math: The Basic plan covers 3,000 app emails. The Free plan costs $0 only if no day goes over its 100-email limit. Before tax.
The Basic 10,000-email monthly package covers 10,000 app emails.
The Foundation 50,000-email monthly package covers 50,000 app emails.
The Scale 100,000-email monthly package covers 100,000 app emails.
